🚀 We’re Hiring | Freshers – Bangalore

📍 Location: Bangalore
🏢 Work Mode: Hybrid
🕒 Shift: Rotational Shifts
💼 Experience: Freshers (0–1 Year)

Job Description:

We are looking for enthusiastic and motivated freshers who are eager to learn, grow, and build their careers in a professional work environment.

Key Responsibilities:

** Support day-to-day business operations and assigned tasks.
** Communicate effectively with internal teams and stakeholders.
** Maintain accurate records and ensure timely completion of tasks.
** Follow established processes and meet quality standards.
** Be flexible to work in rotational shifts.

Eligibility Criteria:

** Freshers with a graduate degree in any discipline.
** Good verbal and written communication skills.
** Basic computer knowledge and willingness to learn.
** Strong problem-solving skills and a positive attitude.
** Willingness to work in a hybrid model and rotational shifts.

📩 Interested candidates can share their updated resumes on sanpillay@deloitte.com
